name: Taiwanese Mahjong
description: Taiwanese Mahjong is a four-player regional Mahjong variant known for local table conventions and expanded tactical tempo compared with some other forms. It keeps classic draw-discard meld structure and fan-based outcome evaluation.

overview.description: Taiwanese Mahjong is a four-player regional Mahjong variant known for local table conventions and expanded tactical tempo compared with some other forms. It keeps classic draw-discard meld structure and fan-based outcome evaluation.

history.origins: Taiwanese table practice evolved from broader Chinese Mahjong traditions with region-specific handling of flow, value, and hand-development tempo.
timeline: 20th century: regional table rules spread in Taiwan.
Modern period: widespread household and club play with stable local conventions.
history.cultural: It is a prominent social and family tabletop game in Taiwan.
history.evolution: Many tables preserve the same core mechanics while adjusting fan thresholds and optional rulesets.

setup.deck: Standard Mahjong set including suited, honor, and bonus tiles.
setup.dealing: Each player receives 13 tiles, with dealer receiving 14 to open play.

rules.objective: Complete a legal winning hand and satisfy local scoring conditions.
rules.gameplay: Players draw and discard in turn. Claims for Chow, Pung, and Kong follow seat and priority constraints. Hand resolution occurs on legal complete structure and table-defined value acceptance.
keyRules: Draw one and discard one in normal turn flow.
Claim eligibility differs by meld type and seat relation.
Winning requires valid structure and accepted table scoring.

strategy.basic: Prioritize flexible waits and avoid isolated dead-end tiles.
strategy.intermediate: Track visible discards and exposed melds to improve safety and efficiency.
strategy.advanced: Choose value routes only when tile flow supports completion before opponents.
tips: Preserve shape flexibility in the first half of a hand.
Shift defensive posture quickly when an opponent accelerates.

synthesis.shortDescription: Taiwanese Mahjong is a four-player regional Mahjong variant with classic draw-discard meld flow and local scoring conventions.
